editingGuide: Edit this file and return it for the weekly update. No website code is needed.
Keep version at 1. Set lastUpdated to YYYY-MM-DD. Events appear in file order.
Keep existing IDs unchanged. New IDs must be unique lowercase words joined by hyphens.
description is a list of paragraphs: the first is the preview; the rest expand into the full story.
tags are categories. Reuse consistent spelling; new tags automatically become filters.
images is a list of objects: {"url":"https://your-image-url","alt":"Describe the image","caption":"Optional credit or context"}. Use already hosted images or existing /assets/ paths.
videos is a list of normal YouTube links. Do not paste iframe HTML or upload video files.
sources is a list of HTTPS reference links. Leave unavailable images, videos or sources as empty arrays.
Preserve factual accuracy and image credits. Do not invent missing historical details.

events.title: Birth of 6b6t
description: Started by qbasty on January 16th, 2022, 6b6t immediately gained traction as the 1.12.2 anarchy server with /tpa and /home.

events.title: Acquisitions
description: During the third month of its existence, 6b6t acquired 7b7t which was about to shut down. The maps were merged together and history was saved.

events.title: r/6b6t subreddit acquired
description: The r/6b6t subreddit was acquired from 6A6K in August.

events.title: No Anticheat Event
description: The first ever event during which the anti cheat was disabled on 6b6t, allowing for uncontrolled chaos and player activity for over 48 hours.

events.title: 6b6t Updates To 1.19.2
description: 6b6t becomes the first anarchy server to upgrade to 1.19 thanks to the experimental software MultiPaper. 2b2t took over a year longer to upgrade.

events.title: IKEA dupes
description: The group IKEA releases 3 powerful dupes between January and May of 2023 abusing MultiPaper.

events.title: Lack Of Growth
description: 6b6t experiences the only period in time when the average player count was around 30. There is no growth without challenges.

events.title: Switching to Folia
description: 6b6t updates to 1.19.4 thanks  to another software called Folia, which brings more stability and performance to the server, resuming the growth.

events.title: First 300+ Player Record
description: During a stream of TheHorizonMC, 6b6t reaches 300+ players for the first time, without any queue, making this a historical achievement for both the marketing efforts of 6b6t and the development team.

events.title: Christmas Event
description: Month long Christmas event with daily quests, bringing the community together and offering new fun ways to spend time on the server.

events.title: Chunk Dupe
description: In February, the most powerful dupe in the server's history would be released, the Chunk Dupe, staying active until August of 2024.

events.title: Autism Inc Auth Exploit
description: In August the group Autism Inc discovered an authentication exploit related to the AuthMeVelocity and PluginMessageListener plugins.

events.title: Update to 1.21.1
description: Server updates to 1.21.1 on September 13th, 2024, under new software "Abomination" - a major version leap.

events.title: Hidden Admin Dupes
description: The 6b6t Team for a period of few months experiments with adding hidden dupes and letting players discover them.

events.title: Christmas Build Competition
description: Another build competition is held on 6b6t, likely the most popular. The results are shown in an video on our YouTube channel. Click here to watch the video.

events.title: Illegals Event
description: A rare illegals event takes place on the server, creating a unique experience for those online.

events.title: Autism Inc finds another Auth Exploit
description: In March Autism Inc logged into qbasty's account leading to the destruction of many bases, which were promptly recovered thanks to Xymb.

events.title: Dupe Patch
description: Last known admin added dupe was patched, resolving a significant issue.

events.title: New Build Competition
description: New build competition in theme of Ancient Civilizations was started, encouraging creativity and community participation.

events.title: Item frame dupe event
description: For 24 hours the item frame dupe would be active again.

events.title: All-Time Player High
description: All Time Player Record 6b6t reaches a brand new record of 580 players online at the same time without a queue. The team announces that 6b6t supporting 1000 players online without a queue is soon going to become a reality.

events.title: Update to 1.21.7
description: Server updates to 1.21.7 on July 29, 2025.

events.title: 6b6t adds new lobbies
description: On November 1 a Halloween lobby and on December 1 a Christmas lobby, both by Volizray get added, the first lobbies in about two years.

events.title: Christmas dupe event
description: On December 27, 6b6t would host a Christmas dupe event which lasted for 72 hours, 6b6t used this chance to test Multi-Abomination for distributed server performance.

events.title: Oldest anarchy server in Hytale
description: 6b6t launched a Hytale server at hytale.6b6t.org.

events.title: 2026 April Fools Event
description: For April Fools 6b6t disabled ElytraFly, placing end crystals and making teleportation cost 1 golden hoe, making for a panic among players.

events.title: 2026 Nether Roof Event
description: Also in April, the Nether Roof would become enabled seeing the construction of the first sky logos on the Nether Roof.

events.title: Version Train
description: 6b6t would update to 1.21.11 on May 30, 26.1 on July 1, 26.1.2 on July 3, and to 26.2 on July 7.

events.title: 6b6t.org blacklisted by Microsoft
description: Microsoft blacklisted 6b6t.org without notice on July 15, however this barely affected 6b6t thanks to AnarchyMod and the efforts to get it implemented into different utility clients.

events.title: 2026 Summer Dupe
description: On August 14, 6b6t would start it's Summer Dupe by enabling different dupes leading to an influx of 1150 players online at the same time, beating 2b2t.
